source_title: What Are Payment Processing Fees For Selling On Etsy
snippet_primary: "Note: Etsy Payments processing fees are subject to VAT. VAT will be collected and appear on the VAT invoice for sellers in required locations."
subject_exact: Etsy policy states Etsy Payments processing fees are subject to VAT in required locations, collected and itemized on VAT invoices for sellers
